observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 15, 2026; Q5, idle ETag): idle instances, a container and a VM on 5.21 and 6.9, showed no ETag change in 5 minutes of 1-second polls. Spurious 412s come only from concurrent writers, so the retry budget of 10 decided in v0.5 stands and L14 is fully resolved. Evidence: runs 20261015T084757Z-g-l14-idle-*.
